core.headline: Two-bedroom maisonette, Streatham High Road, SW16
core.listing:
A two-bedroom maisonette on Streatham High Road, arranged over the first and second floors above a commercial unit with its own entrance. A section 42 lease extension notice has been served and can be assigned to the buyer. The bay-fronted living room measures 4.90m x 4.10m into bay and overlooks the High Road.

The ground floor comprises the living room and a kitchen fitted in 2022 measuring 3.20m x 2.30m. On the first floor are two bedrooms measuring 3.85m x 3.05m and 2.70m x 2.40m, and the bathroom. Heating is by gas combination boiler.

Access is via a rear service yard shared with the commercial unit below, and there is a shared bin store. Parking is not provided; pay-and-display is available on adjoining roads. Streatham station is approx. 6 minutes' walk and Streatham Common approx. 10 minutes' walk.

Offers in Excess of £375,000. Leasehold with 89 years remaining; ground rent £350 per year (doubles every 25 years; next increase 2034); service charge £960 per year (y/e Dec 2025, includes buildings insurance). Council Tax Band C. EPC rating D. The property is above a dry cleaner's on a main road; some traffic noise to the front. The freeholder owns the shop below. There is access via a rear service yard shared with the commercial unit and a shared bin store. The sale involves a chain.
core.summary: Own entrance to a maisonette on Streatham High Road with a bay-fronted living room, kitchen fitted 2022, and a section 42 lease extension notice served that can be assigned to the buyer. Station approx. 6 minutes' walk.
